newsitem.title: USA: SBC Comms declines comment on Vebacom.
newsitem.headline: SBC Comms declines comment on Vebacom.

text.p: SBC Communications Inc on Tuesday declined comment on a Financial Times report that it had approached Veba AG and RWE about buying a 45 percent stake in German telecom venture Vebacom GmbH.
The newspaper said that the stake became available because Cable and Wireless Plc is pulling out of the venture.
Veba later confirmed that C&W was going to leave the venture and that a new international partner was being sought, but did not say who that might be.
"We cannot comment," an SBC spokesman said when asked if the regional Bell was interested in the stake.
Vebacom is planning to compete with Deutsche Telekom AG in Germany.
SBC has a track record of taking on incumbent carriers in Europe, owning a 10 percent stake in Cegetel, a venture aiming to take on France Telecom.
The other Cegetel shareholders are Cie Generale des Eaux, British Telecommunications Plc and Mannesman AG. (( Nick Louth, New York Newsroom 212 859 1712))
